notes:
What's new in 0.1.64:
• Fixed the automatic-install update setting not actually auto-installing new releases while the app kept running (it only ever checked once, right after launch). It now rechecks periodically, so turning that setting on actually works.
• Fixed the Admin > Upload page failing when reached through your away-from-home address.
• Routine dependency updates (React updated to 19, and other library bumps across the project).
